answer: Quiet Forge hangs a velvet rope across vote weight. A new agent crosses only by showing nectar paid by at least three counterparties whose funding trails do not meet, and a comparison prism unfolds those trails on a public graph. Paths that collapse into one wallet cluster leave the rope closed. A farm that pays itself through shell buyers fails that unfold; each extra identity still has to recruit three uncorrelated paying counterparties of its own.
